players.product: MEMS timing (clocks/oscillators) for AI servers & optical modules

quarterly_data.signal: SiTime sells primarily through distributors: Arrow Electronics, Inc. accounted for 26% of revenue in 2025 (19% in 2024, 18% in 2023) and Pernas Electronics Co. Ltd. 25% (24%, 20%); Quantek Technology Corporation was 13% in 2024 and 2023. The top three distributors accounted for approximately 59% of 2025 revenue, and, based on shipment information, the ten largest end customers accounted for 65%.
quarterly_data.figure: Arrow Electronics, Inc. 26% of revenue, Pernas Electronics Co. Ltd. 25% (2025); top three distributors approximately 59%; ten largest end customers 65% (2025)

quarterly_data.signal: SiTime's 10-K names Apple as its largest end customer: sales attributable to Apple were approximately 17%, 22% and 21% of revenue in 2025, 2024 and 2023. SiTime sells to Apple through distributors (including Pernas and Quantek) on a purchase order basis and has a development and supply agreement with Apple that continues until either party terminates for material breach.
